references.text: The same requirement for a goat as a sin offering for a person who has sinned unintentionally
A female of the flock, a lamb, as a sin offering – the same offering requirement
The priest makes atonement for the sin, and that person receives forgiveness
The priest makes atonement for the one who has sinned
The priest makes atonement for the guilty before the Lord
A goat as a sin offering when someone sins unintentionally, and the priest makes atonement
Christ's blood cleanses from sin, unlike the blood of goats and bulls which only provided external cleansing
Blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins – pointing to Christ as the final sacrifice
